_meta.name: English
wideOnHint: Expand the visual to the full window — when the details are too small (Esc to go back)
visualizeHint: Draw a prototype or a diagram of the current intent
drawStuck: The draw has been running for over 10 minutes; regenerate to try again.
agentBusyWarn: The agent has been working for {t}; it may not be listening.
sendWaitingWarn: Send #{seq} went out {ms} ago, the agent has not picked it up yet. You can keep answering — sends are processed in order.
finishedBanner: Finished · the document is written to {doc}{visual}{at}.
serverGoneBanner: The server is unreachable. Resume the grill from the terminal — the tab will reconnect on its own.
noTermsYet: No terms yet. The agent adds them here as they settle.
firstVersionOnWay: the first version is already on its way
outOfDate: Stale · regenerate to take the latest decisions into account
pickQuestion: Pick a question on the left.
sentWaiting: Sent: {bits} on this question — out, the agent is processing
placeholderChange: Change the answer or add a nuance…
placeholderFreeText: A free answer if none of the options fits…
emptyThreadQuestion: Nothing here yet. Ask anything about this question — the agent will answer here on the next send.
exploringWait: Exploring: the agent is building a pros-and-cons table for this question.
emptyThreadVisual: Nothing here yet. Describe what is wrong or missing in the visual — the agent will redraw it on the next send. If a remark contradicts an already answered question, that question will be reopened for you.
sentSeqWaiting: Sent #{seq} — out. The agent is processing, you can keep answering.
nothingStaged: Nothing staged. Pick an option or write in the discussion.
attachFormats: doc · xlsx · pdf · txt · md · image — up to 10 MB
attachHint: It goes out right away and is bound to this question. Interview material, not an archive: what is shorter to show than to tell.
attachTooBig: {name} is {mb} MB, over the limit of 10. Send a summary or a page, not the whole file.
finishSent: The finish is out. The agent is writing the document — the page will update on its own.
finishStale: Finish #{seq} went out {ms} ago, the agent has not picked it up yet. Nothing is lost: it is written to disk and will be processed. You can close the tab — the answers are saved.
finishConfirm: Finish this grill? Everything staged will go out with it; the agent will write the document and stop.
finishReadyTitle: All questions are closed. Finishing will write the document.
